verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an MCP registry and connection platform, but the evidence documents only single-item actions. The CLI commands act on one item at a time (smithery mcp add <url>, smithery tool call <connection> <tool>). Aggregating tools from multiple servers is an adjacent feature, not a documented operation that acts on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
